name: mahdyarief

plugins.name: vision-ocr
plugins.description: Vision OCR plugin for OpenClaude — extract text from images, PDFs, and URLs using RapidOCR (ONNX, CPU)

plugins.name: web-access
plugins.description: Web access for OpenClaude - web search (Exa/Tavily with API key rotation), URL content extraction, site map/crawl, and GitHub search via a local MCP server. Bypasses built-in WebSearch/WebFetch.

plugins.name: markdown-preview
plugins.description: Markdown to PDF/HTML/PNG conversion. PDF engine absorbed from @amitdevx/md2pdf (Playwright/Chromium): Mermaid, KaTeX, syntax highlighting, callouts, TOC, page numbers, 19 themes (14 plugin themes and 5 built-ins), custom CSS themes, headless mode. 3 MCP tools: markdown_to_pdf, markdown_to_html, markdown_to_png.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Context7 documentation lookup for any library/framework with API key rotation. 9 MCP tools: ctx7_resolve_library, ctx7_query_docs, ctx7_add_key, ctx7_remove_key, ctx7_list_keys, ctx7_set_strategy, ctx7_set_limit, ctx7_reset_stats, ctx7_current_key.

plugins.name: documents-reader
plugins.description: Read PDF, DOCX, Excel, and TXT files. Extract text from documents for analysis and processing.

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Persistent project memory via MEMORY.md. Store, search, and incrementally update project knowledge across sessions. SessionStart hook auto-creates MEMORY.md in new projects and injects a bounded section digest.

plugins.name: office-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server for managing Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents (docx, xlsx, pptx) — 47 tools for read, write, edit, format, and export via LibreOffice.

plugins.name: scispace
plugins.description: SciSpace access for OpenClaude — headless Playwright MCP server for literature search on scispace.com using your logged-in (premium) session. 3 tools: search_papers, scispace_login, scispace_status.

plugins.name: trail-code
plugins.description: Trail-code code context graph — 6 MCP tools (trail_find_code, trail_find_all, trail_trace_calls, trail_file_api, trail_repo_map, trail_check_freshness) + auto hooks that inject graph context into prompts, rebuild after edits, track token savings. Requires npm install -g @trailhq/trail-code (CLI: trail).

plugins.name: navigating-docs
plugins.description: INDEX-first local document navigation — fast, zero-RAM keyword search across markdown, PDF, DOCX, XLSX without heavy vector DBs. Bundles nv-index.sh (1KB structural map) + nv-search.sh (parallel ripgrep + pdftotext + pandoc). Skill-only, no MCP server.

plugins.name: pr-slop-guard
plugins.description: PR slop detection — static AST/grep scan + LLM judgment for AI-generated low-quality code before a PR is opened. Verdicts SLOP / SUSPECT / CLEAN with P1/P2/P3 findings. Skill + /slop-check command, no MCP server.

plugins.name: academic-research-skills
plugins.description: Contract-audited academic research pipeline: research → write → review → revise → finalize. 5 skills (deep-research, academic-paper, academic-paper-reviewer, academic-pipeline, sr-screener), 35 modes, 16 slash commands (/ars-*), 4 agents. Skill-only, no MCP server.

plugins.name: slideck-html
plugins.description: Single-file HTML slide decks with PowerPoint-grade output: frozen 1920x1080 template, 19 designs, 10 themes with embedded fonts, 5 motions, placeholder layouts, SVG charts, concept diagrams, PPTX import/export, and PDF export.

plugins.name: journal-scout
plugins.description: Multi-source journal research MCP: Scopus, arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, PubMed, Garuda, Consensus, Exa, Unpaywall, OpenCitations. Unified search with DOI-first de-duplication and metrics context.

plugins.name: paper-assist
plugins.description: Model-free research OS. PaperAssist scaffolds deterministic ideation, experiment, writing, and review packs; the AI harness is the only language model.

plugins.name: fastmcp-browser
plugins.description: FastMCP Browser - lightweight MCP server + WebExtension for AI browser automation. Drives your real browser (Chromium/Firefox) over loopback WebSocket via WebExtensions.

plugins.name: claude-osint
plugins.description: Claude-OSINT external recon skills: 9 skills, 100+ recon capabilities, 80 secret-regex patterns, 80+ Google dorks across 9 categories, read-only passive methodology.

description: Plugins by mahdyarief - one marketplace for web access, browser automation, code intelligence, document tooling, research, slides, and OSINT.
